extracted.intended_audience: trademark owners/holders and U.S.-licensed attorneys preparing a USPTO TEAS Response to Office Action for Post-Registration Matters
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for preparing and submitting a Response to Office Action for Post-Registration Matters through the USPTO TEAS system, including specimen/proof-of-use handling, signature/declaration rules, fees, attorney representation, and form validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Session timeout and save-your-work
rubrics_metrics.description: You're required to log back in after 30 minutes of inactivity. After 25 minutes of inactivity, you will be prompted to continue your session. If you do not continue within 5 minutes, the session will end, you will be logged out of your USPTO.gov account, and you will lose any unsaved data in the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have all information ready before you start; use Save Form to save and resume later; do not rely on browser window state to persist data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not use browser Back/Forward buttons
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not use your browser back/forward buttons: Use only the navigation buttons at the bottom of each page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using the browser navigation may lose form data or break the TEAS workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields must be completed
rubrics_metrics.description: REQUIRED FIELDS: All have an ASTERISK (*), and the form will not validate if these fields are not filled-out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all starred fields are filled before validation and submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported browsers
rubrics_metrics.description: SUPPORTED BROWSERS: Internet Explorer and Edge are not supported browsers for use with this form. Customers must use an alternative browser such as Google Chrome, Firefox or Safari when accessing the Response to Office Action for Post-Registration Matters form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your browser does not show editing keys or functionality, upgrade to a supported browser.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirm registration status before using form
rubrics_metrics.description: To use this form, the 'Current Status' of your registration must be 'A Post Registration Action has been mailed.' Confirm the 'Status' on the STATUS tab of the Trademark Status & Document Retrieval (TSDR) system before proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the registration is not in the correct status, wait until the status updates (usually 48-72 hours after receiving an email notice that a Post Registration Office action has issued).

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering registration number vs accessing saved form
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter Registration Number OR access previously filled-out/saved form. (Do not enter registration number if you are accessing your saved form.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To upload a previously saved form file, first review the TEAS Help instructions for accessing previously saved data and then use the 'Browse/Choose File...' button. WARNING: Failure to follow the TEAS Help instructions will result in the inability to edit your data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not upload other files via saved form upload
rubrics_metrics.description: Do NOT upload or attach any other file(s) (for example, a specimen) using the button below. You must upload other attachments within the proper section of the actual form, after answering 'Yes' to the appropriate wizard question(s) on the next page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uploading attachments in the wrong place can prevent editing or cause processing delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing receipt recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: After this response is submitted, the USPTO will send a filing receipt to the email address of either (A) the appointed attorney, if any, otherwise (B) the trademark owner/holder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm the Primary Email Address for Correspondence is correct before filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status checks availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The status of the filing is available in the Trademark Status & Document Retrieval System (TSDR) 72 hours after filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not expect immediate TSDR availability; check after 72 hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete all known fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Fill out all fields for which information is known. Fields with a * symbol are mandatory for filing purposes and must be completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide as much complete information as possible to avoid processing issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature options and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign the response form on the Signature Page. Options: electronically forward the Signature Page for an electronic signature (Text Form), mail/fax for handwritten pen-and-ink signature, or electronically save the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a declaration is required, the declaration must be signed by the owner/holder or a person properly authorized to sign on behalf of the owner/holder under Trademark Rule 2.193. To electronically sign, enter alpha/numeric characters preceded and followed by '/' (e.g., /john doe/). Examples of acceptable 'signatures' include: /john doe/; /jd/; or /123-4567/.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validate form on Validation Page before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Validation Page, it is critical to confirm that all information is displayed properly immediately before filing, regardless of the appearance of the data at any point earlier in the process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any previously-entered argument text or image files are missing, re-enter or re-attach before final submission; otherwise the USPTO will not receive a complete response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay/Submit and payment methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Click on the Pay/Submit button at the bottom of the Validation Page. If a fee payment is required, you may choose from credit card, automated deposit account, or electronic funds transfer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After successful transmission you will see SUCCESS! and receive an email acknowledging receipt. You must complete the payment process within 30 minutes of accessing the payment screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: You must respond explicitly to each refusal/requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Review the Office action and then answer 'Yes' to any question that directly relates to a requirement and/or refusal raised in the Office action. You must respond explicitly to each refusal and/or requirement and enter the responses in the proper place in the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least one answer to the wizard questions must be 'Yes.' A RESPONSE WITH ONLY YOUR SIGNATURE IS NOT ACCEPTABLE except when the only issue raised was an unsigned or improperly signed original filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership change and supporting documents
rubrics_metrics.description: If ownership has changed and you would like Office records updated to reflect the change of ownership, you must record appropriate documents with the Assignment Recordation Branch. Otherwise, you may provide a detailed explanation of the change and supporting documents with your response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to record assignments may leave records inconsistent; provide documents or explanation as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correcting mistakes in maintenance filings
rubrics_metrics.description: To correct a mistake in the maintenance filing, you must explain the nature of the mistake. A post registration examiner will review your response to determine if the mistake can be corrected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear explanation and supporting evidence; some corrections may require a separate Section 7 request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 7 request for owner information changes
rubrics_metrics.description: To correct a mistake in the current owner's information, you must file a Section 7 request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Section 7 when changes would otherwise alter owner information materially in the record.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to submit substitute specimen
rubrics_metrics.description: *NOTE: To submit a 'substitute specimen' to overcome a refusal, also answer 'Yes' to #2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If responding to a Proof of Use Audit and you need to submit a substitute specimen, ensure you also answer 'Yes' to the Proof of Use question as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof of Use Audit response
rubrics_metrics.description: **NOTE: To submit 'proof of use' in response to a Proof of Use Audit, also answer 'Yes' to #3.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If responding to a Proof of Use Audit, follow the Proof of Use submission instructions and provide required evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of allowed modifications to identifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Only modifications to correct obvious typographical errors or to delete goods/services/classes in the identification of goods/services/the nature of the collective membership organization are permitted without a Section 7 Request. Other changes, including to clarify or limit the goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization, require a Section 7 Request. Adding to or broadening the scope of the goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization is not permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do NOT add or broaden goods or services using this form; deletions are permanent and may not be reinserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use this form for deletions and corrections only
rubrics_metrics.description: Use this form to: (1) delete goods and services; (2) delete an entire class; or (3) correct obvious typographical errors; but never to add to or broaden the goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need to amend beyond these limited actions, use Section 7 or other appropriate filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen attachment rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions: Attach ONLY the specimen here. Failure to follow this instruction will cause significant delays in the processing and review of your filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sound and motion specimens are not non-traditional and MUST be submitted using this form (i.e., not mailed). If mailing a non-traditional specimen, check the USPS mailing box only if it meets qualifications. Describe what the submitted specimen consists of.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webpage specimen requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REQUIRED FOR WEBPAGE SPECIMENS: Enter webpage URL(s) and date(s) of access below if it DOES NOT appear on the attached specimen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the webpage URL and date accessed (MM/DD/YYYY) when specimen is a webpage or when URL is not visible on the specimen itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checking box for specimens submitted/unverified adds declaration language
rubrics_metrics.description: CHECK THIS BOX IF SPECIMENS ARE NOW BEING SUBMITTED OR WERE PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED UNVERIFIED IN THE INITIAL FILING. Checking this box will automatically add the following declaration language to the form: 'The substitute (or new, or originally submitted, if appropriate) specimen(s) was/were in use in commerce during the relevant period for filing the current declaration of use' OR 'The attached specimen is a true copy of the specimen that was originally submitted with the declaration of use' [for an illegible specimen]. NOTE: If submitting a substitute specimen or verifying a previously submitted specimen, you must provide a signed declaration when prompted before submitting your response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only check when true and be prepared to provide a signed declaration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof of Use submission method
rubrics_metrics.description: Proof of Use Submissions: Delete goods/services from those displayed below by returning to the Mark Information page. Answer YES to the question asking whether you want to 'delete goods, services, or an existing class.' Select the appropriate radio button in each class section. Provide proof of use by listing each audited item separately. Add a section for additional goods/services by clicking 'Provide Additional Proof of Use'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the per-class submission requirements; list each audited item separately to ensure examiner can process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous statement usage
rubrics_metrics.description: MISCELLANEOUS STATEMENT: Enter information here ONLY if no other section of the form is appropriate. Failure to follow this instruction will cause SIGNIFICANT DELAYS in the processing and review of your submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this field only as a last resort; do not use it for attachments where a specific section exists (e.g., substitute specimen).

rubrics_metrics.name: File size and format limits for attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: To attach your file: Click on the button below to select the file in JPG/PDF format (not exceeding 5 megabytes per attachment for JPG or 30 megabytes per attachment for PDF) or .WAV, .WMV, .WMA, .MP3, .MPG, or .AVI format (not exceeding 5 megabytes for sound files or 30 megabytes for motion files).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not exceed stated file sizes/formats; larger files will be rejected or cause delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deletion of an item/class is permanent
rubrics_metrics.description: Any item deleted from the listing of goods/services/nature of the collective membership organization will be PERMANENTLY DELETED from the registration and may NOT be reinserted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider permanence before checking the 'DELETE INTERNATIONAL CLASS' box.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification amendment under Section 7 rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Use this page to amend the registration under §7 of the Trademark Act ... to adopt the international classification set forth in the current version of the Nice Agreement. Changes to the classification must be consistent with how the USPTO currently classifies those goods/services pursuant to the latest version of the Nice Agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a specimen is required for added classes, attach specimen; see TMEP § 1609.10(a) for correcting a USPTO error that would materially change the registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy of statements and fraud warning
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements made in filings to the USPTO must be accurate; inaccuracies could result in the cancellation of a trademark registration. Lack of use on all goods/services for which use is claimed in a post-registration filing with the USPTO could jeopardize the validity of the registration and result in its cancellation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure factual accuracy; do not claim use where none exists; false statements may lead to cancellation and potential penalties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence attachment scoping
rubrics_metrics.description: Evidence Instructions: Attach ONLY supporting evidence or argument(s) here, not specimens, proof of use, or the entire response to Office action. Each portion of this form services a specific purpose for data processing reasons. Failure to follow this instruction will cause significant delays in process and review of your filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place each file in the correct section (Evidence vs Specimen vs Proof of Use) to avoid delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Argument entry rules and formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Entering your argument(s): You may type directly into the box or cut-and-paste. If your browser supports enhanced functionality you can format entry (font, size, color, bold, italics, etc.). Do NOT include any html or other programming code or language that may create links within the argument section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no editing keys displayed, upgrade browser; after completing the argument click 'Save and Return to Form' and avoid using the browser 'X' to close the window as it may delete entered information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimens vs evidence vs proof distinctions
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions emphasize strict separation: do not submit specimens in the Evidence section; do not submit proof of use in the specimen upload; each portion of form serves specific data-processing purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully read section headings and only place the correct item type in each upload field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner/holder and correspondence email rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The owner/holder is required to provide an email address and keep that address current with the USPTO. If the owner/holder is represented by a U.S.-licensed attorney, only the attorney's email address will be used for correspondence by the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary Email Address for Correspondence is used for official communication; ensure it is correct. USPTO not responsible for failures due to recipient's anti-spam or email issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public record and confidentiality notice
rubrics_metrics.description: All information you submit to the USPTO at any point in the application and/or registration process will become public record, including your name, phone number, email address, and street address. By filing this document, you acknowledge and agree that YOU HAVE NO RIGHT TO CONFIDENTIALITY in the information disclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit confidential banking or credit card information except in secure payment section; be mindful that data remains public even if registration abandoned or surrendered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address and field character limits
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: You must limit your entry here, and for all remaining fields within this overall section, to no more than 40 characters (the storage limit for the USPTO database). You may need to abbreviate some words, e.g., St. instead of Street. NOTE: You must limit your entry here to no more than 22 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abbreviate where necessary to avoid truncation; failure may result in undeliverable address or data truncation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domicile vs mailing address rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The mailing address is presumed to be the owner's/holder's domicile address. To provide a domicile address that is NOT the same as the mailing address, use the Change Address or Representation form. The domicile address is not publicly viewable unless it is the same as the mailing address. In most cases, a P.O. box, 'care of' address, or similar variation is not acceptable as a domicile address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter accurate domicile info when required; do not use P.O. box for domicile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attorney representation and changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign-domiciled owners/holders must have a U.S.-licensed attorney represent them before the USPTO in any application or registration-related filing. If a newly appearing U.S.-licensed attorney files this form or you update bar info, the USPTO will presume that you are the owner's/holder's attorney and will automatically update Attorney of Record and Correspondence Address data fields. Powers of attorney end upon (1) the date of registration; or (2) the final acceptance or denial of a post registration maintenance filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that filing under an attorney's credentials updates the record and that representation will continue for related filings unless revoked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attorney contact and bar membership data limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Attorney entries require Year of Admission, U.S. State/Commonwealth/Territory, Bar Membership, Membership Number ('N/A' or number). Docket/Reference Number field limited to no more than 12 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate bar and contact data; follow character limits to avoid truncation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration language and penalties for false statements
rubrics_metrics.description: To the best of the signatory's knowledge, information, and belief, formed after an inquiry reasonable under the circumstances, the allegations and other factual contentions made above have evidentiary support. The signatory is warned that willful false statements and the like are punishable by fine or imprisonment, or both, under 18 U.S.C. § 1001, and that such willful false statements and the like may jeopardize the validity of this submission and the registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure truthfulness and reasonable inquiry before signing; false statements carry criminal penalties and may invalidate the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may sign and signatory identification
rubrics_metrics.description: If a declaration is required, the declaration must be signed by the owner/holder of the registration or a person properly authorized to sign on behalf of the owner/holder under Trademark Rule 2.193. Only one signature is required for the declaration. The person(s) signing for each section may be different, depending on who has the required knowledge to sign. For an individual owner/holder enter 'Owner' or 'Holder'; for business entity enter official title; for U.S.-licensed attorney enter 'Attorney of record' and at least one state bar admission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signatory must be authorized and the signature must be personally provided. Examples of acceptable electronic signatures include /john doe/; /jd/; /123-4567/.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple owner/holder signatures
rubrics_metrics.description: If more than one trademark owner/holder, ALL must sign the overall submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all owners sign where required to avoid defects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response signature legal authorization confirmations
rubrics_metrics.description: You must click one of the three buttons below to confirm that you are legally authorized to sign this form based on the trademark rules governing representation of others before the USPTO. If you have a U.S.-licensed attorney representing you, only your attorney can sign this Response. Owner/Holder who is not represented: confirm you are owner/holder or authorized person and that any prior attorney has been revoked or withdrawn. Authorized U.S.-Licensed Attorney: confirm active bar membership and representation status. Authorized Canadian Attorney/Agent: confirm an authorized U.S.-licensed attorney has been appointed and reciprocal recognition under 37 C.F.R. §11.14(c)(1). Foreign attorneys (other than authorized Canadian attorneys/agents) may not sign responses and are prohibited from representing a trademark owner/holder before the USPTO in trademark matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the correct signer type and ensure statutory requirements for representation are met; foreign attorneys (non-Canadian) cannot sign.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee selection and multipliers
rubrics_metrics.description: To pay a fee for any of the items that may be listed below in the 'Additional Fees' portion, use the pulldown menu in the 'Multiplier' column to 'activate' that fee choice. Repeat as necessary. The 'Overall Total Amount' will reflect all selected 'Additional Fees,' along with any 'Required Fees,' if specifically so designated in the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activate the correct multipliers and verify the Overall Total Amount before payment; fee tables list amounts for Section 8, 9, 15, Section 7, divisional fees, additional processing fees, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment timing and confirmation
rubrics_metrics.description: You must complete the payment process within 30 minutes of accessing the payment screen. A complete transaction will result in a screen that says SUCCESS! Within 24 hours, an email acknowledgment will also be sent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not prepared to complete payment, Save Form and return later; after clicking Submit you cannot return to modify the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save Form and re-open saved data procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: To download and save the form data, click on the Save Form button at the bottom of this page. The information will be saved to your local drive. To begin the submission process with saved data, you must open a new form, and click on the 'Browse/Choose File' button displayed on the initial form wizard page. Clicking 'Continue' will properly open the saved version of your form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow TEAS Help instructions to resume saved forms correctly; improper restore may prevent editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character conversion warning
rubrics_metrics.description: WARNING: After submission of this form, some characters may be displayed in a manner different from what was originally entered because various USPTO systems cannot display/print certain characters. The USPTO will convert any problematic character(s) to the closest acceptable equivalent(s). Visit the USPTO's website for a complete table highlighting which characters will be converted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid using exotic characters when possible; review converted output in final records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review before final submission and finality
rubrics_metrics.description: STEP 1: Review the data in various formats ... STEP 2: If there are no errors and you are ready to file, confirm the Primary Email Address for Correspondence. STEP 5: If you are ready to file: Click on the Submit button ... WARNING: After clicking the button, you can NOT return to the form to modify the data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review thoroughly and print copies for your records; corrections after submission may not be permissible and may affect legal rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples and tips for miscellaneous fields (stippling, mark type, mark update)
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the appropriate radio button to indicate Mark type: Standard Characters, Special Form (Stylized and/or Design), Non-visual Mark. STIPPLING AS A FEATURE OF THE MARK: Check this box to indicate that the stippling is a feature of the mark and does not indicate color. STIPPLING FOR SHADING: Check this box to indicate that the stippling is for shading purposes only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use correct checkboxes to describe mark representation; after previewing the USPTO-generated image, if you object to the display of the mark, select Special Form.
